input: Book a couples massage for our anniversary

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The date of the anniversary determines how urgently the booking needs to happen and whether availability will be tight.
The city or neighbourhood determines which specific spas or venues are even relevant to search.
Massage type (Swedish, deep tissue, hot stone, etc.) directly affects which venues qualify and what to request when booking.
Budget sets the tier of spa to target — a $100 total cap points to a very different venue than a $400+ luxury experience.
Atmosphere preferences (hotel spa, boutique day spa, resort, in-home service) shape which type of venue to prioritise.
Knowing whether either partner has physical sensitivities, injuries, or pressure preferences affects what to communicate to the spa at booking.
Understanding what extras matter most (champagne, rose petals, private suite, add-on treatments) defines what a successful booking actually looks like.

gold.taskTitle: Book a couples massage for your anniversary
gold.taskDescription: Find and reserve a couples massage experience at a suitable venue in time for the user's upcoming anniversary.

questions.title: What date is your anniversary?
questions.description: The exact date determines booking urgency and how to handle availability constraints.

questions.title: What city or area should the spa be in?
questions.description: The location narrows the search to venues that are actually accessible to the user.

questions.title: What style of massage are you hoping for?
questions.description: The massage type (e.g. Swedish, deep tissue, hot stone) determines which spas offer a suitable service.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the experience?
questions.description: Budget sets the tier of spa to target and filters out venues that are over or under the desired spend.

questions.title: Do you prefer a hotel spa, boutique spa, or in-home service?
questions.description: Venue type shapes the atmosphere and the overall experience beyond just the massage itself.

questions.title: Do either of you have injuries or pressure preferences the spa should know?
questions.description: Physical considerations need to be communicated at the time of booking to ensure the right therapist and technique are assigned.

questions.title: Which extras matter most to make it feel special?
questions.description: Knowing which add-ons are priorities (e.g. champagne, private suite, rose petals, robes) defines what a successful booking looks like beyond just securing a time slot.
